question: What secret would instantly end your relationship if it got out?
story: My girlfriend thinks her cat ran away two years ago. That cat did not run away. That cat moved. When we started dating, I was deathly allergic, but she kept saying she could never love a man who didn't love her cat. So I made a decision. My grandmother lives four streets over. She was lonely. The cat was fluffy. You see where this is going. I told my girlfriend the cat slipped out the window, and then I helped her put up missing posters. Of her own cat. That was living with my grandma. Here's the part that keeps me up at night. Sometimes we visit my grandmother for Sunday dinner, and the cat sits there, staring at my girlfriend, and she says, wow, grandma's cat looks JUST like Whiskers. Babe. That IS Whiskers. And I will never tell you.
